'''Makoto Mizobuchi''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|溝|みぞ}}{{ruby|渕|ぶち}}{{ruby|誠|まこと}}}}''' ''Mizobuchi Makoto'') is the creator of several [[Pokémon manga]] series. Aside from Pokémon, Mizobuchi is also known for ''The Gate Keeper of Hell's History'', ''Zoids Battle Card Warriors - Commander Teru'', ''Hidemaru the Soccer Boy'' and ''Iron Soul!! Zoids Hand-to-Hand Fighting''. Mizobuchi has also illustrated for the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]], illustrating {{PAGESINCATEGORY:Illus. by Makoto Mizobuchi}} card.

==Pokémon manga by Makoto Mizobuchi==
* [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team]] (2005-2006)
* {{ma|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea}} (2006)
* {{ma|Pokémon Battle Revolution}} (2006)<!--Bessatsu CoroCoro Comics Special February 2007 (December 28, 2006)-->
* [[Pocket Monsters Diamond and Pearl: Regigigas Major Capture Operation!!]] (2007)
* [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing Exploration Team]] (2007-2008)
* {{ma|Arceus and the Jewel of Life}} (2009)
* [[Pokémon HeartGold SoulSilver: Pokédex Completion Comic]] (2009)
* [[Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Challenge!]] (2015-2016)
* [[Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Leave It to Pikachu!]] (2016-2019)
